newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-MARITIMO PLAYER QUITS OVER FLYING FEAR.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MARITIMO PLAYER QUITS OVER FLYING FEAR.

text.p: Portuguese under-21 international Tiago Pereira of Maritimo has quit the Madeira club saying he is scared stiff of flying in and out of the island's tiny airport.
Pereira, whose contract was to have run until 1998, also said the Portuguese first division side had not paid his salary for two months.

It will be up to the Portuguese Football Federation to decide whether the reasons given are sufficient grounds for ending his contract with Maritimo, the leading club on the mid-Atlantic holiday islands that are a two-hour flight from Lisbon.
"I am not afraid of flying, just of landing at that airport with its short runway," Pereira said.
The player is widely reported to be seeking a transfer to Lisbon club Benfica.
